body: Consolidated macOS live-testing findings, sorted by severity (each also recorded as a thread risk; full write-up in ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/E2E-REPORT.md, macOS section and its follow-up):U+000AU+000ABlocksU+000AU+002D MB1 Settings screen invisible to VoiceOver (macOS AX tree keeps the previous screen). Risk 01M3JKF0GTRKDWP9JBZKTVN0K4.U+000AU+002D MB2 Daily reminder never appears on the Mac; no build registered for notifications; silent cancel; ad-hoc signing suspected. Risk 01M3JKF0GT8H8FN5S2778ETFWA.U+000AU+000AHurtsU+000AU+002D H1 Month picker invisible to VoiceOver when open; only Escape leaves.U+000AU+002D H2 Floated photo cannot be placed between paragraphs beside it (c5 finding 1, changed form).U+000AU+002D H3 Edit menu Undo/Redo disabled, Paste/Select All dead (real mouse confirmed; Flutter-level).U+000AU+002D H4 Ctrl+K dead in every field (c5 finding 3; Flutter-level).U+000AU+002D H5 Focus lost after Cancel then Keep editing.U+000AU+002D H6 Text fields unnamed for VoiceOver.U+000AU+002D H7 Sidebar items exposed as text, no button/tab role or selected state.U+000AU+002D H8 Escape does not close the voice recorder.U+000AU+002D H9 No visible keyboard focus indicator (Settings).U+000AU+002D H10 Settings Export/Delete all rows respond only on the button (same as Android).U+000AU+002D H11 Chinese Pinyin cannot compose in the note editor.U+000AU+000ACosmetic: C1 to C8 (empty line after photo removal or drag; recorder timer overlaps Camera; 0:09 vs 0:08; floating pill over title bar; 1 Sprouts / 1 days; unlabelled search clear and text-size slider; 12-hour picker vs 24-hour row and flaky typed entry; leftover temporary voice file).U+000AU+000ANot reproduced / harness: c5 finding 2 (file-URL paste) was the pasteboard helper; real Finder copy and drag work. Dead-key failures came from in-app injection; real keys work. The month-picker crash is probe-only.U+000AU+000APassed on the Mac: M0 to M15, Finder copy and drag, accents, Japanese, full screen, Light/Dark (light-only by design), spell check (plain), sound (memo, mood change).U+000AU+000AAndroid findings stay as recorded on c2 (risks) and in the report's Android sections (B1 to B4, H1 to H14, C1 to C10 fixed on 2026-09-24/25; open items from the phone verification of PRs #208 to #211 are the c2 risks).
